tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe expanded the sink-gradient span from 0.018 to 2.17. A saturating source with two-layer sink inhibition and a positive square-root branch fits all seven paid observations with training RMSE about 2.3e-8. Submit this law for fresh confirmation at H = 0.6.

considered_alternatives.option: Two-layer siphon with a linear branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its training RMSE is about 0.0116, whereas the square-root branch matches all seven observations to their reported precision.

considered_alternatives.option: Two-layer siphon with the archived rho range fixed
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The widened gradient observations identify rho near 0.912, outside the archived 0.69–0.72 range.
The seven observations identify all three coefficients of the static law at the target horizon; trajectory measurements would add cost without resolving a remaining ambiguity at that horizon.
